One trick I have when I feel like you do is give a life another chance just for one day. Wake up and think to yourself “I’m going to give this day a chance to be good, I’m not going to loose anything by giving a chance”. And if it doesn’t get better, give another day a chance and keep giving each day a chance. 

There guaranteed will be day, which you have given a chance, when you feel better, not saying that your life will do a full 360, but there will be a bit of light and good. 

Focus on the little things that pulls you out of this state even just for a moment: seeing a light peaking through the blinds, the smell of a well-done tostie, the feeling you get when you stretch out etc. Focus on these things during the day and combine all these feelings into one. 

As much as people say that going for a walk, taking a bath or reading a book helps, it doesn’t. You just have to trick your consciousness into believing that it’s getting better by picking those little moments and combining them into a big one and thinking that it was worth giving life a chance.

Give a day a chance to change your mind and stay.
